data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Elisheba', meaning 'My God is abundance'. The name Bethsina is a derivative, meaning 'House of Wine'. In the Bible, there is a city called Bethsheba, which was famous for its vineyards. The name Bethsina carries the meaning “House of Wine” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bethsina usually hope their child will grow to embody house of wine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
